requirements.text: Implement the smallest deterministic research-only readout that summarizes existing sensor-family relationship evidence using the canonical relationship vocabulary, distinguishes historical from prospective evidence and exposes presentation roles for double-count prevention without changing weights or market semantics.
Known related sensor/test families are represented using only canonical relationship classes with exact source/test IDs and evidence class/sample status.
Presentation roles PRIMARY/VALIDATION/AUDIT_ONLY/DATA_BLOCKED/UNRESOLVED are clearly non-weighting metadata and preserve unresolved states.
Low Pearson/Spearman correlation alone cannot produce UNIQUE.
No sensor is removed, promoted, reweighted or counted as independent confirmation by this readout.
